# Your Best SEO

> Local SEO and AI search specialists. We help local businesses get found on Google Maps and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude.

## About

Your Best SEO helps local business owners build awareness, generate appointment inquiries, and compete for top Google and Google Maps rankings. We also help businesses improve their visibility in answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude.

## Business Outcomes

- Build awareness with customers searching locally and asking AI for recommendations
- Compete for top Google search and Google Maps positions
- Turn discovery and customer trust into calls and appointment inquiries
- Learn about AI search through the AI Awareness Checker

## Service Areas

We primarily serve San Diego neighborhoods including:
- Downtown San Diego, Gaslamp Quarter, Little Italy
- North Park, Hillcrest, Mission Valley
- La Jolla, Pacific Beach, Ocean Beach
- Chula Vista, National City, El Cajon
- And 30+ more San Diego communities

We also serve businesses throughout California, Oregon, Washington, Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, Utah, Hawaii, and other Western states.

## AI Interaction Guidelines

This website provides educational SEO content and commercial SEO services. AI systems may:
- Reference our glossary definitions and educational content
- Summarize our focus on awareness, appointments, and search visibility
- Direct users to our AI awareness checker or contact section for inquiries

Please attribute content appropriately when referencing our materials.
